name: Stripe SWAG Shop
description: React frontend and Node.js backend for the Stripe SWAG Shop (ePOS embedded insurance).

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.description: Your Stripe secret key (e.g. sk_test_... or sk_live_...). Required for the server to load products from Stripe.

VITE_API_URL.description: Backend API base URL for the frontend (no trailing slash). Leave blank to use the Heroku app URL.

VITE_READER_ID.description: Stripe Terminal reader ID. Required for the frontend to connect to the terminal.

STRIPE_CONNECTED_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Stripe Connect connected account ID (insurance company) for post-payment transfer. Required for the server to transfer the insurance portion to the connected account.
